name: incident-edge-ledger-filter-cost-and-scope
body: The ledger filter costs one extra ledger query per non-empty call: a fresh connection plus `MATCH (n:PendingRemoval) RETURN n.fqn ORDER BY n.fqn`, built into a `BTreeSet` before the per-table loops (an empty-FQN call still returns before the read, and on a clean handle the ledger is empty so the steady state is one cheap statement). Upgrade to a single ledger-filtered pass if per-mutation admission over a large durable spec becomes hot. Note also that `node_files_from_db` still reconstructs both edge halves unfiltered — the residual half that the save boundary's pairing check refuses — so the ledger's containment is enforced here on the in-edge reconstruction only.
